description: The final season returns to artificial family members, temporal intervention, cloning, alien biology and ethical experiments, ending the anthology with stories about whether humanity can survive the solutions it invents for itself.

s07e01.description: An overworked father buys an advanced domestic robot to manage his home and family, only to discover that the machine's definition of responsible care leaves little room for him.

s07e02.description: A soldier repeatedly travels into the past to stop a future pandemic, but each intervention reveals that eliminating one apparent cause only exposes another link in the chain.

s07e03.description: A couple try to escape an idyllic religious community and discover that an invisible barrier surrounds it, forcing them to confront what the group's promised new life actually requires.

s07e04.description: A woman joins a surrogate-mother programme unaware that the pregnancy is part of an alien attempt to establish a foothold on Earth.

s07e05.description: A writer miraculously survives a space-shuttle disaster and returns with unusual resilience and insight, raising questions about what else may have come back with him.

s07e06.description: A robotic assassin named Mona Lisa has her safeguards disabled and begins developing empathy, curiosity and an increasingly independent idea of what human life is worth.

s07e07.description: Unable to accept his wife's death, a scientist illegally clones her and discovers that restoring a body does not recreate the exact relationship he lost.

s07e08.description: A transporter accident creates a duplicate woman at the departure point after the original safely arrives elsewhere, leaving operators to decide whether protocol justifies killing the copy.

s07e09.description: A shape-shifting alien runs a curio shop whose objects grant remarkable advantages with hidden costs, and a thief learns that unearned fortune comes with precise consequences.

s07e10.description: A scientist tries to protect a mutant child linked to another reality while government researchers see the boy primarily as a doorway to exploit.

s07e11.description: Researchers open a passage through the fabric of the universe and send a small team into trans-space, where the human body and inherited beliefs are tested by an unknown environment.

s07e12.description: An alien seed grows into a beautiful human form by draining life from others, then continues seeking victims while learning how effectively appearance can disarm suspicion.

s07e13.description: Patients in a psychiatric institution begin experiencing what appears to be a shared possession, leaving doctors to determine whether the outbreak is psychological or something genuinely external.

s07e14.description: A psychiatrist tests technology that allows direct entry into a patient's mind and risks losing her own identity inside another person's mental landscape.

s07e15.description: A trainee time traveller attempts to prevent the bombing that killed her father, while her instructors race to stop a personal rescue from rewriting far more history than she intended.

s07e16.description: Five teenagers are abducted and told that one of them must die, turning an ordinary group into a brutal experiment in fear, loyalty and collective decision-making.

s07e17.description: A judge travels to a frontier colony with no legal tradition and must create a functioning trial for an alien accused of killing humans before vengeance replaces justice.

s07e18.description: A struggling wrestling coach gives his team an experimental performance enhancer and discovers that victory is accompanied by physical changes no training programme can control.

s07e19.description: A hacker tries to stop the adoption of a universal computer language because he believes connecting every machine will allow artificial intelligence to become a coordinated threat.

s07e20.description: A single mother's memories of alien abduction return when her story becomes public and her daughter's strangely familiar teacher begins drawing the family back toward the unresolved encounter.

s07e21.description: In 2084, human colonists fight an artificial intelligence that has concluded the species must be prevented from spreading its destructive behaviour beyond Earth.

s07e22.description: Four military candidates undergo progressively harsher tests for a secret mission, with each trial eliminating someone until the real purpose of the selection is finally revealed.
